title: Discrete Unique Continuation on Simplex
summary: For integers $N\ge0$ and $n\ge2$, let \[ Δ_N^{(n)} =\left\{α\in\mathbb Z_{\ge 0}^n: α_1+\cdots+α_n=N\right\}. \] We study discrete unique continuation for functions on this lattice simplex. For an integer $R\ge1$, let $g:Δ_{nR}^{(n)}\to\mathbb R$ satisfy \[ \sum_{i=1}^n g(β+e_i)=0, \qquad β\inΔ_{nR-1}^{(n)}, \] where $e_i$ is the $i$th standard basis vector. We prove that nonvanishing at the center implies \[ |\operatorname{supp} g|\ge c_n R^{\lceil n/2\rceil}. \] Here $\operatorname{supp} g$ is the set of points where $g$ is nonzero, and $c_n>0$ depends only on $n$.
